q: Which diseases are associated with BRCA1?
banner_text: Palade, Elion and Mendel found 98 records

Researcher

Changes in this gene account for roughly 40% of inherited breast cancers and over 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers combined.⁠23 I found 4 conditions related to BRCA1.⁠1–4

BRCA1 is a gene that works as a tumor suppressor and helps keep genetic material stable in cells.⁠23

WHERE THIS ANSWER COMES FROM
Familial cancer of breast	⁠1
Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1	⁠2
Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4	⁠3
Fanconi anemia complementation group S	⁠4
BRCA1	⁠5, 9
Egr-1 regulates the transcription of the BRCA1 gene by etoposide.	⁠6

BRCA1 DNA REPAIR-ASSOCIATED PROTEIN; BRCA1	⁠8
